heading: INT. VENDING MACHINE REPAIR DEPOT - WAREHOUSE FLOOR - MORNING

units.text: INT. VENDING MACHINE REPAIR DEPOT - WAREHOUSE FLOOR - MORNING
Rows of dead snack machines stand against the corrugated walls, dozens of glass faces glowing faintly with the light of nothing.
A forklift idles in an aisle.
The air smells of cold coffee and burnt wiring.
DELIA ACHTERBERG, forties, in an orange safety vest two sizes too big, perches on a stool among the machines with a clipboard on her knee.
She has been counting the same row for an hour.
Her pen taps once for each machine, a metronome of grievance.
The service door clangs open.
Sunlight cuts across the floor.
NORBERT PIMM, fifties, regional quality manager, enters in a pressed suit and shiny brogues, carrying a leather folio and the faint air of a man who has never once been in a warehouse.
He stops.
He sees the machines.
He sees Delia.
He smiles.
Delia! There you are.
units.name: NORBERT

units.text: Here I am.
units.name: DELIA

units.text: I come bearing news.
units.name: NORBERT

units.text: You always do.
units.name: DELIA

units.text: Norbert advances through the aisle, picking his way between puddles of oil, and sets the folio on a machine labelled OUT OF ORDER.
Delia lifts her pen and sets it down on the clipboard without a sound.
Norbert opens the folio, closes it, opens it again, and places a single sheet of paper in her lap.
Your position has been reclassified.
units.name: NORBERT

units.text: To what?
units.name: DELIA

units.text: Synergy Associate.
units.name: NORBERT

units.text: That's not a job.
units.name: DELIA

units.text: It's a journey.
units.name: NORBERT

units.text: She stands.
The clipboard slides to the floor.
She takes a step toward him and he takes one back, bumping a machine, which dispenses a lone packet of crisps with a mechanical sigh.
Both of them look at it in silence.
Eleven years, Norbert.
units.name: DELIA

units.text: And we value every one of them.
units.name: NORBERT

units.text: She picks up the crisps.
Tears the packet.
Eats one, slowly, looking at him, and drops the empty bag at his feet.
That machine has been broken since 2019.
units.name: DELIA

units.text: Then it's an exciting time for it.
units.name: NORBERT

units.text: Delia laughs, a low terrible sound, and then she is not laughing, and the forklift beeps in the distance like a heart monitor in the quiet.
